title: MRS QUEST GUI
features:
FEATURES AND WHAT THEY DO:

Teleport to Heart Key, teleports you to the Heart Key Table in Hospital
Item Teleporter Loader, gives you a gui in which you can grab items 
Teleport to Heart Key Lock,  teleport you to the fridge in carnival might need Noclip on 
Keep track of Memory game, gives you a text box so you can write down the colors
Puzzle pieces ESP, gives you a highlight see through wall view of the puzzle pieces in plant
Teleport to TNT placement, teleports you to the lab so you can trigger boss fight
Hospital and Carnival exit, teleports you to the exits for the maps
Noclip can be toggled allows you to walk through walls



FOLLOW INSTRUCTIONS STEP BY STEP TO HELP MAKE MRS P SKIN QUEST EASIER, INSTRUCTIONS LISTED BELOW: 

USING ACTIONS ON WRONG MAPS MAY RESULT IN DEATH, HERES HOW TO USE THE GUI FIRST GET ITEM TELEPORTER AND COMPLETE HOSPITAL THEN TELEPORT TO HEART KEY AND INPUT 0524 NEXT GO TO CARNIVAL AND UNLOCK THE DOOR THEN TELEPORT TO HEART KEY LOCK AND PUT APPLEPIE THEN THERE WILL BE A MEMORY GAME USE THE KEEP TRACK OF MEMORY GAME TO TAKE NOTES THEN GET THE TOY BOX ON THE FERRIS WHEEL, NEXT GO TO PLANT AND ENABLE PUZZLE PIECE ESP TO FIND PUZZLE PIECES WHILE COMPLETING THE MAP ONCE  YOU HAVE TNT TELEPORT TO TNT PLACEMENT AND USE THE ITEM TELEPORTER TO GET THE ITEMS
